# RedwoodSDK: Type-Safe Navigation with linkFor

## Background
A RedwoodSDK project is pre-installed at `/home/user/myapp`. Use `linkFor` from `rwsdk/router` to build a typed `link` helper, and use it inside server components so that every link in your HTML output is generated from the typed helper (no hard-coded path strings on the page).

## Requirements
Extend `src/worker.tsx` with the routes below (all under the existing `render(Document, ...)` block) and create a `src/app/shared/links.ts` file that exports a typed `link` constant created from `linkFor<App>()` (where `App` is the type of the default export from `src/worker.tsx`). Use that `link` helper inside the page components.

- `GET /home`: server component HTML must contain an `<a>` element whose `href` is generated by calling `link("/about")` and whose visible text is `About`. It must also contain an `<a>` whose `href` is generated by calling `link("/users/:id", { id: "42" })` and whose visible text is `Show user 42`.
- `GET /about`: HTML must contain an `<a>` whose `href` is generated by calling `link("/home")` and whose visible text is `Back to home`.
- `GET /users/:id`: HTML must contain the text `User profile: <id>` (with the URL param substituted).
